how: Round 3: the 1,704 things to do that round 2 got no Google Maps result for were searched again with a longer wait (1,457 place pages, 227 result lists). Five showed closed; each was opened again on Maps and checked on the web.

rows.name: Old Rothenburg Craftsman’s House
rows.evidence: Maps: Temporarily closed. The row's tip already says open Easter to 31 October, closed in winter (rothenburg.de).

rows.name: Alpsee Bathing Spot and Boat House
rows.evidence: Maps: Temporarily closed. The row's tip already says summer only, the bath opens about May (hohenschwangau.de).

rows.name: Cézanne’s studio
rows.evidence: Maps list: Temporarily closed. The official site says the Atelier des Lauves reopened for summer 2026 after restoration; the press kit gives 4 July–31 October 2026, the next reopening in spring 2027. Season note added and the source changed to the official page.

rows.name: Than Thip Waterfall, Khao Kho National Park
rows.evidence: The batch landed on a park ranger unit's pin (หน่วยพิทักษ์อุทยานแห่งชาติเขาค้อที่ ขค 1), which is marked Permanently closed. The waterfall's own Maps place (น้ำตกธารทิพย์, 4.5, tourist attraction) shows no closure; no 2026 closure notice found. The map query now names the waterfall's own place.

rows.name: Khon Kaen Philatelic Museum
rows.evidence: Maps, by its English and Thai names, lands on this very museum (พิพิธภัณฑ์ตราไปรษณียากรขอนแก่น, 3.7): Permanently closed. Khon Kaen keeps 19 things to do, 7 indoors.
